name: Fleet Line Item 6
definition: Supplies additional transaction information for fleet transactions.

AllowedItem.name: Allowed Item
AllowedItem.definition: Indicates whether or not the requested product or service is allowed.||True = Allowed|False = Not allowed

Fuel.name: Fuel
Fuel.definition: Indicates whether or not the line item represents a fuel or non-fuel product or service.

ServiceType.name: Service Type
ServiceType.definition: Type of service received at the acceptor location.

ProductCategory.name: Product Category
ProductCategory.definition: Contains a code that identifies a category of fleet products or services.

ProductCode.name: Product Code
ProductCode.definition: Code that identifies the type of fuel or non-fuel product or service being purchased.

UnitOfMeasure.name: Unit Of Measure
UnitOfMeasure.definition: Unit of measure of the item purchased.
